content: Me niŋ Bepaŋdi kotigoŋ yanagitdok yoŋa ninadiguk
Bepaŋ, du nibukwihita tiŋa binibuguŋ kaŋ mik gineŋ fafaŋe mu tugumun. Iŋgoŋ kamiŋ kotigoŋ buŋa nihitubu-lodaweŋ.
Du kwetnik i tiŋa mahamut tuguŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa kwet agaŋ tubutawaguŋ kaŋ ginaŋ yatak. Kaŋ kobuk kwet i agaŋ kadakadapmawe tilak, unduŋ doktiŋa kotigoŋ tutumbaweŋ.
Metamgeye inditok malabumuŋ fee hinek nimguŋ. Woŋ adi da wain ime nimbune naaŋ nadibubuye tugumun nabugoŋ.
Du fek niŋ kwehene-tiloweŋ, kaŋ me du’walaŋ hebekeneŋ hatiiŋdi u kaŋ memikhiye yabu-momoŋ buŋa uŋoŋ busuwaaŋ kulemaŋgoŋ hatneeŋ.
Du nibukahile hinek tilaŋ, doktiŋa yonadinik u nadinimiŋa da’walaŋ saŋiniŋge loloŋnit wendi kotigoŋ ninigileŋ, kaŋ indi kulemaŋgoŋ kedem hatinim.
Bepaŋ adi yolineŋ hali indiŋ yolak, “Nu mik gineŋ agaŋ fafaŋeeŋ yalakapmegut, doktiŋa Sekemhi’walaŋ kwet eŋ Sukomhi’walaŋ kwet gutuŋ u metamneyedok daneyemtawit.
“Gileat dut Manase adi natok. Eŋ Ifeleim adi mik mebimokopne fafaŋeniŋ. Kaŋ Juda adi mapme kuyaŋne.
“Iŋgoŋ Moaphi tiŋa Idomhi adi tipilapilaye kwanai tinamneeŋ. Tiŋa Filistiahi dut mik tiŋa yalakapmegut doktiŋa nadifooŋ kakali tilat.”
Bepaŋ, yokwet wapum gimbahaŋ fafaŋeniŋnit gineŋ uŋoŋ nediyeŋdi nanagila wek? Be Idomde nediyeŋdi nanagila wek?
Bepaŋ, du agaŋ sigilulum be tinimguŋ? Du mikmeniye kotigoŋ tuwot mube yehitubu-lodaweŋ?
Meeniŋdi nihitubu-lodaneŋ iŋgoŋ wondi nemek nemu tibek. Wendoktiŋa dagoŋ kedem nihitubu-lodaune memikniye dut mik tinim.
Bepaŋdi nihitubu-lodawek woŋ, indi mik gineŋ fafaŋe tiŋa widihidapmanim. Bepaŋ negoŋ memikniye u kedem yehiyalifilidawek.
